<thought>The spectrum shows a monoisotopic peak at ~199 and a second peak at ~201 (M+2) with almost equal intensity (~100% of the base peak). This 1:1 M/M+2 pattern is characteristic of a single bromine atom. No other element shows a uniquely diagnostic pattern in this data. Therefore, bromine can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
